summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc., a Cayman Islands holding company listed on Nasdaq under MTEN, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 457,355 Class A ordinary shares at $2.00 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,022,645 Class A ordinary shares at $1.99995 per warrant, with a nominal exercise price of $0.00005 per share. In a concurrent private placement, it will issue unregistered warrants for up to 1,480,000 Class A ordinary shares. Placement agent FT Global Capital Inc. receives warrants for 111,000 shares at $2.40 each, subject to a 180-day lock-up under FINRA Rule 5110(e)(1). The filing is a standard shelf takedown registering a stock-plus-warrant financing, not a special situation.
